cases.name: Dorothy Ann "D'Ann" Horton Fontain
cases.about: Her obituary said, "(She) was lovingly referred to as “Joey” by her family. D’Ann was a resident of Woodbridge, Virginia at the time of her death. D’Ann loved her job at CVS Health, where she felt she was making a difference in other people’s lives. She, in turn, was beloved by her co-workers. Like her daughter, Empress, D’Ann loved to sing and dance. They both loved art and D’Ann was passionate about photography. Empress, a kindergartener at Mary Williams Elementary School in Prince William County, was outgoing and impressed all who knew her with her larger-than-life personality."

cases.name: Empress Johanna Madine Fontain
cases.about:
Her mother's obituary said, "Empress... loved to sing and dance (and) loved art. Empress, a kindergartener at Mary Williams Elementary School in Prince William County, was outgoing and impressed all who knew her with her larger-than-life personality."

Her father Divine Fontain described his relationship with (her mother) Dorothy as complicated, but said what wasn't complicated was their love for Empress and their other children.

"She created a spark in me. I'd put on the little tutu and sit at the table and play tea with her. Dorothy always said she got you wrapped around her fingers and she knows it. She was a light for this world and she didn't get to shine all the way," said Fontain.
